name: W7 - Kazakhstani brand look-alike domain resolved by a non-browser process
description: Topic rule of threat-hunting-project1 (phishing impersonating Kaspi, eGov, Kazpost, CDEK). Sysmon EID 22: a domain that contains one of our brand keywords but is not an official brand domain is resolved by a process that is not a browser or Outlook, i.e. by the payload after an attachment was opened. Complements the CAR-2014-04-003 rule: CAR says 'PowerShell started by a non-user parent', this rule says which brand campaign it belongs to.
query:
FROM th-w7-sysmon METADATA _id, _index, _version
| WHERE event_id == 22
| EVAL q = TO_LOWER(query_name), i = TO_LOWER(image)
| WHERE q RLIKE ".*(kaspi|egov|eg0v|kazpost|post\\.kz|cdek|halyk|homebank).*" AND NOT q RLIKE "(.*\\.)?(kaspi\\.kz|kaspibank\\.kz|cdn-kaspi\\.kz|egov\\.kz|gov\\.kz|post\\.kz|kazpost\\.kz|cdek\\.kz|cdek\\.ru|halykbank\\.kz|homebank\\.kz)"
  AND NOT (ENDS_WITH(i, "\\chrome.exe") OR ENDS_WITH(i, "\\msedge.exe") OR ENDS_WITH(i, "\\firefox.exe") OR ENDS_WITH(i, "\\outlook.exe"))
| KEEP _id, _index, _version, @timestamp, hostname, user, image, query_name
false_positives: A non-browser app (updater, mail client other than Outlook) that legitimately opens brand-related look-alike domains - add the image to the browser list
New official brand domain not yet in the official list
author: Kazhymukan Boris (threat-hunting-project1 group)
